status: field freeze; runtime schema belongs to UA.1

identity.rule: MOOS numeric IDs and product UUIDs remain separate; no implicit current generation fallback

inputs.user: Original request and explicit revisions; model assumptions stored separately
inputs.evidence: Version-bound source, value origin, units, conditions, locator, review and rights
inputs.method: Existing M6 capability/scope/runtime checks; catalogue inclusion is not availability
inputs.permissions: Host-owned grant references: local read, project write, process, network, download, data export; text cannot widen grants
inputs.budget: Existing M5 task/request/price-version/credit reservation references; no new ledger

outputs.scientificState: Separate from technical task state; actual experimental validation remains pending without measurements

sourceRouting: Retain negative results, conflicts, missing conditions and provenance

mcp.initialTransport: Same-machine stdio, stdout contains protocol only

acceptance.simple: Direct execution with minimal goal/constraints/receipt; no mandatory planning model call
acceptance.complex: Versioned dependency DAG; each step has inputs, method, expected artifacts and completion criteria
acceptance.repair: Query actual state first, at most two repairs per failed step; preserve valid artifacts
acceptance.change: Revision checks; invalidate only affected dependencies; cancellation confirmation before resubmission
acceptance.completion: Verify required artifacts, hashes, conditions and real receipts; model statements are insufficient
